description: bigville R22 / newspaper-writer Rung A (block 293000): the gather-and-publish role is a PORTABLE held goal + affordance, not a hardcoded reporter. A Resident who `affords` a makes_known Affordance is (1) employed by the town's Paper via a RULE (pub_employ_afforder) and stops being employed when it no longer affords it (pub_unemploy_non_afforder), so the writer FOLLOWS the affordance; and (2) acquires the general gather goal Goal{kind:know} (pub_role_gathers). No Python picks the reporter; move the affords edge and the role moves. Gibsonian: the publisher is whoever affords making-things-known.

rules.name: pub_employ_afforder
rules.comment: The town's Paper employs a Resident who affords a makes_known Affordance. This DERIVES the writer from the held affordance instead of a Python role-pick. Guarded by Not-already-employed so it fires once and reaches a fixpoint.

rules.name: pub_unemploy_non_afforder
rules.comment: The Paper stops employing a resident who no longer affords a makes_known Affordance, so the employs edge FOLLOWS the affordance rather than accreting. Together with pub_employ_afforder this makes the publish role portable: move the affords edge and the writer moves.

rules.name: pub_role_gathers
rules.comment: A resident who affords makes_known acquires the GENERAL gather goal Goal{kind:know} if it holds none — the publish role BUNDLES the gather goal (the same general goal any curious agent holds). Guarded by Not-already-pursuing-a-know-goal so it mints exactly once.
